value.old: Lycan and units under his control mark units on attack for %mark_duration% seconds. When Lycan or a unit under his control attacks a marked unit, it deals bonus damage equal to %bonus_damage%%% of its attack damage per stack, and heals the attacker for %lifesteal%%% of its attack damage per stack. Only units within %mark_range% range of Lycan can apply new marks.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

value.old: The Ancient Thunderhide slams his mammoth foot against the ground, sending %pulse_count% shockwaves, each smaller than the last. Every wave damages enemies it catches and throws them off their footing, slowing their movement and attack speed. Heroes regain their balance more quickly.
